DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃の紙に二つ番号があり、契約番号を口座番号の欄へ入れかけました。確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃契約番号を口座番号欄へ入力しかけ確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two numbers on my rent notice, and I nearly entered the contract number in the account number field. I'd like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you nearly entered the rent contract number in the account number field, and ask for help checking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振込みはまだ実行していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't made the transfer yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。確認画面へ進む前に、番号の前に契約と書いてあることに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実行前で契約ラベルに気づいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. Before going to the confirmation screen, I noticed that it said ‘contract’ before the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you noticed the contract label before making the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 契約管理の番号と銀行口座の番号は別です。請求元の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The contract management number and the bank account number are different. Do you have instructions from the biller?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この紙です。どの情報をどの欄へ入れるか、請求元にも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 請求紙を示し請求元へ各欄意味照会を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the notice. I'd also like to ask the biller which information goes in each field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the bill in Japanese and say you would like to ask the biller what each field means.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からないまま実行せず、正しい振込情報を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't proceed while you are unsure. Check the correct transfer details first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いったん操作をやめます。二つの番号をつなげて長い口座番号にも作りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 操作中断し二番号結合で口座番号を作らないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll stop for now. I won't join the two numbers together to make a longer account number either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will stop and will not create an account number by joining the two numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。銀行では受取先情報を推測して補うことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The bank cannot guess and fill in the recipient's details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 請求元へ番号の意味を確認してからやり直します。契約番号を口座番号に置き換えて送金しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 請求元確認後再操作し契約番号による送金をしないと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll start again after asking the biller what the numbers mean. I won't send money using the contract number in place of the account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will try again after checking with the biller and will not transfer money using the contract number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認ができましたら、操作案内もご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Once you have checked, please ask us if you need help with the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋に自分が買っていないパンがあります。隣の方の買物を入れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未購入パンが自分袋に混入し隣客品の可能性を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is bread in my bag that I didn't buy. I may have put the next customer's shopping in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that bread you did not buy ended up in your bag and may belong to the customer beside you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋詰めした場所と、レシートを確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your receipt and where you packed your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 共有の台です。自分のレシートにパンはなく、隣に同じ袋が置かれていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共有台とレシート未記載・隣の類似袋を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was the shared counter. There is no bread on my receipt, and an identical bag was beside mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese about the shared counter, the bread not being on your receipt, and the similar bag beside yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだどなたの物か断定できません。こちらで品と会計の確認をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't yet be certain whose it is. We'll check the item and the payment details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 隣の方に勝手に渡さず、パンを袋から分けて店員さんへ預けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 所有者断定せず本人で隣客へ返さず店員預けを申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't hand it to the next customer myself. I'll take the bread out of my bag and leave it with a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer in Japanese to leave it with staff without deciding who owns it or returning it to the next customer yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ご自身の商品が不足していないかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Please also check whether any of your own purchases are missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 買った牛乳と卵はあります。パン以外に違う品は見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人牛乳卵ありで他異品未発見と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the milk and eggs I bought. I can't see any other items that aren't mine besides the bread.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you have your milk and eggs and have found no other unfamiliar items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認ができるまで、このパンを持ち帰らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please don't take this bread home until we have checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の品とレシートを確認し、余分なパンは店員さんへ渡して持ち帰りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人品レシート確認と余剰パン預け未持帰りを復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check my purchases and receipt, hand the extra bread to a staff member, and not take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will check your own items and receipt, leave the extra bread with staff, and not take it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。パンはお預かりしました。確認へのご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We have taken the bread. Thank you for helping us check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベンチで絵を乾かしていますが、休憩したい方が来ました。まだ濡れている紙をどこへ移せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れた絵を置いたベンチに休憩客が来たため移す場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm drying paintings on the bench, but someone has come who wants to rest. Where should I move the paper while it's still wet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that someone wants to rest on the bench where your wet paintings are, and ask where to move them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ベンチ全体に置いていますか。紙を運ぶ板などはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are they covering the entire bench? Do you have a board or something for carrying the paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三枚並べたので座る場所がありません。画板は一枚だけで、紙を重ねると色が移りそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三枚で座面を占有し画板一枚しかなく重ねると色移りが心配と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've laid out three sheets, so there is nowhere to sit. I only have one drawing board, and I'm worried the colors will transfer if I stack the sheets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that three sheets occupy the seat, you have only one drawing board, and you are worried about colors transferring if you stack them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 共有のベンチを空けましょう。ご自身の道具の中に、一枚ずつ支えられる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's clear the shared bench. Do you have anything among your own supplies that can support the sheets separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 空の画材箱と厚い表紙のスケッチブックがあります。その上に分けて載せられそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空の画材箱と厚いスケッチブックに紙を分けて載せる案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an empty art supply box and a sketchbook with a thick cover. I think I can place the sheets separately on those.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest in Japanese placing the sheets separately on your empty art supply box and thick sketchbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 風で飛ばないように持てますか。移した紙で通路をふさがないことも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you hold them so they don't blow away? Also make sure the moved sheets don't block the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に箱を持ってもらい、私が画板と本を持ちます。通路の外で立って乾くのを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人と台を分担して持ち通路外で紙が乾くのを待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask my friend to hold the box, and I'll hold the drawing board and the book. We'll stand outside the walkway and wait for them to dry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you and your friend will each hold the supports and wait outside the walkway for the sheets to dry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ベンチに絵の具が付いていないかも見てください。付いていたら係員へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also check whether any paint has got on the bench. If it has, let an attendant know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙を三つの台に分けて友人と持ち、ベンチを空けます。座面を確認し汚れがあれば係員へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三枚を分けベンチを空け座面の汚れを確認して必要なら係員へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll put the sheets on three separate supports and hold them between us to free up the bench. I'll check the seat and tell an attendant if it is dirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will separate the three sheets, clear the bench, check the seat for stains, and notify an attendant if necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。周りの方も使えるようにして、写生をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please enjoy sketching while allowing others to use the facilities too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 連れと席が別の車両です。発車前に同じ車両へ走って移るより、降りてから合流したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者別車両で発車前移動を避け降車後合流を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My companion and I have seats in different cars. I'd like to meet up after getting off instead of running to the same car before departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your companion is in a different car and ask about meeting after getting off, avoiding moving cars before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 到着駅は同じですか。指定された席はそのまま利用する予定ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you getting off at the same station? You plan to use your assigned seats as they are, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、同じ駅です。車内で探し歩かず、自分の席に座ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同一降車駅で車内探索せず本人指定席利用と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, at the same station. I'll sit in my own seat and won't walk around the train looking for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are getting off at the same station and will use your own reserved seat without searching through the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 到着駅の分かりやすい合流場所を調べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look for an easy-to-find meeting point at your arrival station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 改札を出た案内板の前がよいか、到着駅の図で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着駅改札外案内板の合流適否を図で照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can we check the station map to see whether in front of the information board outside the ticket gates would be a good spot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to use the arrival station map to check whether the information board outside the gates is suitable for meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内図では改札外に案内板があります。到着時の現地表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The map shows an information board outside the ticket gates. Please also check the signs there when you arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこを連れへ送ります。先に着いた方もホームで反対方向へ探しに行かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合流場所を連れへ連絡しホーム相互探索を避けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll send that location to my companion. Whoever arrives first won't go searching in the opposite direction along the platform either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your companion the meeting point and avoid searching for each other on the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。駅が変更になった場合には、改めて連絡を取り合ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If your arrival station changes, please get in touch with each other again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の席で移動し、同じ降車駅の改札外で合流します。乗り遅れそうな移動はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定席移動と降車後改札外合流で発車前走行しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll travel in my own seat and meet my companion outside the gates at the same station where we get off. I won't move around in a way that risks missing the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will use your reserved seat and meet outside the gates after getting off, without running around before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気をつけてご旅行ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語の通知を相談したいです。友人が金曜に来られるので、窓口も予約できたと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人金曜同行可を窓口予約と誤認したため通知相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like advice about a notice in Japanese. My friend can come on Friday, so I thought that meant I had an appointment at the counter too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook your friend's availability to accompany you on Friday for a counter appointment, and ask for advice about the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金曜の窓口予約は申込みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you applied for a Friday appointment at the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。友人の予定だけ確認しました。窓口の受付時間は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口未申込受付時間未確認で友人予定のみ既知と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I've only checked my friend's schedule. I haven't looked at the counter's opening hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not booked or checked the counter's hours and only know your friend's availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人の予定と窓口の予約は別ですね。必要な言語を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your friend's schedule and the counter appointment are separate matters. What language do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。友人に全部任せず、自分でも質問を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望ベトナム語で本人質問確認も行いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Vietnamese. I want to check my questions myself too, rather than leaving everything to my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like Vietnamese support and also want to check your questions yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる支援と予約方法を担当へ確認します。金曜以外の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about available support and how to book. Would another day besides Friday work for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水曜の午後も相談できます。友人と来るかは窓口の案内を聞いてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水曜午後代案を示し同行は窓口案内後判断と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can also come for a consultation on Wednesday afternoon. I'll decide whether to come with my friend after hearing the counter's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Offer Wednesday afternoon as an alternative in Japanese and say you will decide about your friend's company after receiving the counter's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。予約できた場合は日時と支援方法を控えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you get an appointment, please make a note of the date, time, and type of support.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人の空きだけで予約済みと考えず、窓口と支援の受付を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人空きと窓口支援予約を区別して確認すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume it's booked just because my friend is free. I'll check the arrangements for both the counter and language support.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will distinguish your friend's availability from booking counter services and support, and check both.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談担当へおつなぎします。通知をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll put you in touch with the consultation staff. Please bring the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ出す紙に自分で症状を書きました。これを病院の診断書として出してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自作症状紙を病院診断書として提出可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote down my symptoms myself on a sheet to submit to my employer. Can I submit this as a medical certificate from the hospital?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may submit your own symptom notes as a hospital medical certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身のメモと医療機関が発行する書類は違います。会社の指定は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your own notes are different from documents issued by a medical institution. Do you know what your employer requires?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 休んだ理由が分かる紙と言われました。正式な書類名は聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社は休暇理由紙のみ指定で正式名未照会と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They asked for a paper explaining why I was absent. I haven't asked for the official document name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your employer only requested a paper explaining your absence and you have not asked for its formal name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず提出先が何を必要とするか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, please check what the recipient requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の症状メモに病院の名前を足して正式な診断に見せることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 病院名追記で正式診断に装わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't add the hospital's name to my own symptom notes to make them look like an official diagnosis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not add a hospital name to present your notes as an official diagnosis.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要書類が分かったら、発行の手続きと費用をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you know which document you need, we can explain the issuing procedure and fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は自分のメモとして保管し、会社へ必要な書類名を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自作メモとして保持し会社へ必要書類名照会を行うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: For today I'll keep this as my own notes and ask my employer the name of the document they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep it as your personal notes and ask your employer what document is required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。診断書が必要なら医師への相談も含めて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you need a medical certificate, we'll check the process, including consulting a doctor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社の指定を聞いてから発行を相談します。自作の症状メモを病院発行の紙とは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先指定確認後発行相談し自作メモを病院発行としないと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask about having it issued after checking my employer's requirements. I won't describe my own symptom notes as a hospital-issued document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will check the recipient's requirements before discussing issuance and will not represent your notes as hospital-issued.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な書類が分かりましたらお声がけください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know once you know which document you need. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布がありません。スーパーで隣の方のかごに黒い物が見えましたが、自分の財布かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不明財布と隣客かご黒物を未同定として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find my wallet. I saw something black in the basket of the person beside me at the supermarket, but I don't know whether it's my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help in Japanese about your missing wallet and an unidentified black object in the next customer's basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その物を確認したり、相手に取られたと伝えたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked that object or told the person they took it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: していません。他人のかごを開けず、店員に財布が見当たらないと相談しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手非難も他人かご開披もせず店員へ紛失相談済みと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I didn't open anyone else's basket. I told a staff member I couldn't find my wallet and asked for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you neither accused the person nor opened their basket, and have already asked staff about your missing wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見た物と推測を分けて伺います。最後にご自身の財布を使った場所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask you to distinguish what you saw from what you inferred. Where did you last use your wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後二時ごろレジです。その後に袋詰めをし、かばんへ戻したかは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 午後二時レジ使用後袋詰めでかばん戻し不明と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At the register around two in the afternoon. I packed my shopping afterward, and I don't remember whether I put it back in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you used it at the register at around 2 p.m., packed your shopping afterward, and do not know whether you returned it to your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 財布の特徴を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 黒い二つ折りで角に赤い糸があります。かごの黒い物では糸まで見えませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人財布赤糸特徴と隣かごでは糸未視認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's a black bifold with red stitching on one corner. I couldn't see any stitching on the black object in the basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between the red stitching on your wallet and the stitching you could not see in the next person's basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その違いも含めて確認します。カードの発行元へも対応を相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check with that distinction in mind too. Please also ask your card issuers what action to take.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 隣の人が持ったと断定せず、最後の使用場所と財布の特徴を伝えます。カードの対応も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他人持去り断定せず使用地点特徴報告とカード対応照会を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't state that the person beside me took it. I'll explain where I last used it and describe the wallet. I'll also check what to do about my cards.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not conclude someone took it, will report its last use and distinguishing features, and will ask what to do about your cards.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が状況を確認します。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person in charge will check the situation. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の荷物の再配達を頼むつもりで、家族の不在票を見ていました。送信前に気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 兄名義不在票番号で本人再配達入力しかけ未送信と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was looking at a family member's missed-delivery notice while intending to request redelivery of my own parcel. I noticed before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you nearly entered your older brother's missed-delivery number for your own redelivery, but have not submitted it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前をそれぞれ確認できますか。二枚ともお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check the names on each? Do you have both notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。片方は私、もう片方は兄の名前です。番号を読んだのは兄の方でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人票と兄票二枚で読んだ番号は兄と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. One has my name, and the other has my older brother's. The number I read was from my brother's notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have two notices, yours and your older brother's, and the number you read was his.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の票を分けて確認してください。お兄さんの荷物も受け取りたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please separate your own notice and check it. Do you also want to receive your brother's parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 兄の分の手続きはまだ頼まれていません。勝手に同じ日時へ変更しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄依頼なしで兄荷物日時を無断変更しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: He hasn't asked me to arrange his delivery yet. I won't change it to the same date and time without his permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your older brother has not asked you to do this and you will not change his parcel's delivery time without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ではご自身の票の条件を確認しましょう。入力はもう送信しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let's check the conditions on your own notice. Have you submitted your entry yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。兄の番号を消して、自分の票から必要な情報を確認し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未送信で兄番号消去後本人票を確認し直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I'll delete my brother's number and check the necessary information again using my own notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not submitted it, will delete your brother's number, and check your own notice again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付方法の案内を見て、ご本人の荷物の希望を入力してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please read the instructions on how to request redelivery and enter your preferences for your own parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の名義と番号を合わせて再配達を頼みます。兄の票は別にして本人へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人名義番号一致で再配達依頼し兄票を本人へ渡すと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll request redelivery with my own matching name and number. I'll keep my brother's notice separate and give it to him.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will request redelivery using your own matching name and number and give your brother his notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。送信前の確認をお願いします。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check before submitting. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先に口座情報を出します。通帳の最初のページを切って渡そうと思いましたが、その前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先の口座情報提出のため通帳ページ切取りを考え実施前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to submit my account details to my employer. I was thinking of cutting out the first page of my bankbook to give them, but I'd like to ask before doing that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you considered cutting out a bankbook page to submit account details to your employer, and ask for advice before doing so.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原本のページを提出するよう、勤務先から指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did your employer specifically ask you to submit an original page?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には口座番号が分かる資料とだけあります。まだ切っていませんが、途中の取引のページも付けようと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号確認資料の指定のみで原本要求未確認・切取り未実施と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions only say to provide material showing the account number. I haven't cut anything out yet, but I was also thinking of including some of the transaction pages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that only material showing the account number was specified, the need for an original has not been confirmed, and you have not cut anything out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な項目と提出方法を勤務先へ確認してください。通帳そのものを切り離す必要があるとは決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask your employer which details are needed and how to submit them. Don't assume that you need to detach pages from the bankbook itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 原本はこのまま残します。口座の情報と取引の履歴が別のページにあることも、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原本を保全し口座情報ページと取引履歴ページの違いを確認したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll keep the original intact. I'd also like to check that the account information and transaction history are on different pages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will preserve the original and want to check the distinction between account information pages and transaction history pages.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 該当箇所の見方を担当がご案内します。コピーする場合も、提出先の指定を先に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will show you how to find the relevant section. Even if you make a copy, let's check the recipient's requirements first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手が残高まで求めているとは書いてありません。全部をコピーせず、必要な項目とページを勤務先へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残高要求未確認で全頁コピーせず必要項目と頁を勤務先へ照会すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It doesn't say they need my balance too. Instead of copying everything, I'll ask my employer which details and pages they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a balance requirement is unconfirmed and you will ask your employer which details and pages are needed instead of copying every page.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。提出に必要な範囲が分かったら、その内容で資料を準備できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Once you know what is required for submission, you can prepare the material accordingly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切取りはせず、勤務先に必要項目とコピー可否を確認します。口座情報を示す箇所だけを準備し、原本を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原本未切断で項目コピー可否を確認し必要範囲の資料準備と原本持帰りを答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't cut anything out. I'll ask my employer which details they need and whether a copy is acceptable. I'll prepare only the section showing the account details and take the original home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the original intact, check the required details and whether copies are accepted, prepare only the necessary material, and take the original home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通帳の該当箇所をご案内します。切る前にご相談いただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll show you the relevant section of your bankbook. Thank you for asking before cutting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さきほど買った洗濯ばさみが袋にありません。袋詰めの台に置いたかもしれないので確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入洗濯ばさみが袋になく袋詰め台置忘れの確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The clothes pegs I bought earlier aren't in my bag. I may have left them on the packing counter, so I'd like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check whether you left your purchased clothes pegs on the packing counter because they are not in your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入のレシートはありますか。どの台をお使いでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the receipt? Which counter did you use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このレシートにあります。入口側の台です。お金は払っていますが、持ち帰ったか不確かです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシート購入済と使用台及び持帰り未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're on this receipt. I used the counter near the entrance. I've paid for them, but I'm not sure whether I took them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the receipt shows your purchase, identify the counter you used, and say you are unsure whether you took the item home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届いている商品を確認します。購入済みであることと、未受領の可能性は分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the items that have been handed in. We'll distinguish the fact that you paid from the possibility that you did not receive them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートの項目を消してほしいのではありません。店に残っているか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会計項目削除ではなく店内残置品照会を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm not asking you to remove the item from the receipt. I want to know whether it's still in the store.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are asking about an item left in the store, not requesting removal of a charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。パックの色や個数は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the person in charge. Do you know the pack's color and the number of pegs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い洗濯ばさみ十個入りです。まだ新しい同商品を棚から取ってはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青色十個入特徴と棚から代替品未取得を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It contains ten blue clothes pegs. I haven't taken another new pack of the same item from the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the pack of ten blue pegs in Japanese and say you have not taken a replacement from the shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その特徴とレシートで照合します。確認後にお受取りをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll match those details against the receipt. Once we have checked, we'll explain how to collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシートと青い十個入りを照合して受け取ります。棚の商品を自分で代わりに持って行きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特徴レシート照合後受領し棚から自己補充しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll collect it after the receipt is matched with the pack of ten blue pegs. I won't take a replacement from the shelf myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will collect it after its features and receipt are checked and will not take a replacement from the shelf yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認いたしますのでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait while we check.
